description_en: Asynchronously collects the full request statistics in the SQL Explorer results of a database instance by SQL ID
description_zh: 调用GetFullRequestStatResultByInstanceId接口，按照SQL ID异步统计数据库实例SQL洞察结果中的全量请求数据
name: GetFullRequestStatResultByInstanceId

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that was used to create the database instance.

This parameter is optional. The system can automatically obtain the Alibaba Cloud account ID based on the value of InstanceId when you call the GetFullRequestOriginStatByInstanceId operation
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID，即创建数据库实例的阿里云主账号ID。

非必填，输入目标数据库实例ID后，在调用API接口时，系统会自动获取用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

You must specify the node ID if your database instance is a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The SQL ID.

If this parameter is specified, the full request statistics of the specified SQL query are collected. If this parameter is left empty, the full request statistics of the entire database instance are collected
parameters.help_zh:
SQL ID。

填写SQL ID时，统计目标SQL ID的全量请求数据；为空时，统计整个数据库实例的全量请求数据
parameters.name: sql_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the client that executes the SQL statement.

This parameter is optional. If this parameter is specified, the full request statistics of the specified IP address are collected. If this parameter is left empty, the full request statistics of the entire database instance are collected
parameters.help_zh:
执行SQL的客户端IP地址。

非必填，输入目标客户端IP地址后，统计目标客户端IP地址的全量请求数据；为空时，统计整个数据库实例的全量请求数据
parameters.name: origin_host

parameters.help_en: The keywords that are used for query
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The start time can be up to 90 days earlier than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询开始时间需要在数据库实例SQL洞察存储时长范围内，最大不能早于当前时间90天
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The interval cannot exceed one day
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且查询开始时间和查询结束时间的间隔不能超过1天
parameters.name: end

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the returned entries. Default value: count. Valid values:

count: the number of executions.

avgRt: the average execution duration.

rtRate: the execution duration percentage.

rowsExamined: the total number of scanned rows.

avgRowsExamined: the average number of scanned rows.

avgRowsReturned: the average number of returned rows
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认为count。

count：执行次数。

avgRt：平均执行时间。

rtRate：耗时比例。

rowsExamined：总扫描行数。

avgRowsExamined：平均扫描行数。

avgRowsReturned：平均返回行数
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to sort the results in ascending order. By default, the results are not sorted in ascending order
parameters.help_zh: 升序排序开关，默认关闭
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码，从1开始，默认为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页数据量，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement. Valid values: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, LOGOUT, MERGE, ALTER, CREATEINDEX, DROPINDEX, CREATE, DROP, SET, DESC, REPLACE, CALL, BEGIN, DESCRIBE, ROLLBACK, FLUSH, USE, SHOW, START, COMMIT, and RENAME.

If your database instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, a PolarDB for MySQL cluster, or a PolarDB-X 2.0 instance, the statistics can be collected based on the SQL statement type
parameters.help_zh:
SQL语句的类型，取值包括：SELECT、INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE、LOGIN、LOGOUT、MERGE、ALTER、CREATEINDEX、DROPINDEX、CREATE、DROP、SET、DESC、REPLACE、CALL、BEGIN、DESCRIBE、ROLLBACK、FLUSH、USE、SHOW、START、COMMIT和RENAME。

当数据库实例为RDS MySQL、PolarDB MySQL版、PolarDB-X 2.0时，可以通过SQL语句类型进行统计
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The role of the node in the PolarDB-X 2.0 instance. Valid values:

polarx_cn: compute node.

polarx_dn: data node
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB-X 2.0数据库实例节点信息。

polarx_cn：计算节点。

polarx_dn：数据节点
parameters.name: role

Fail.description_en:
Indicates whether the asynchronous request failed. Valid values:

true

false
Fail.description_zh:
请求是否失败。

true：是。

false：否

IsFinish.description_en:
Indicates whether the asynchronous request was complete. Valid values:

true

false
IsFinish.description_zh:
异步请求是否执行完成。

true：是。

false：否

AvgExaminedRows.description_en:
The average number of scanned rows.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for MySQL databases
AvgExaminedRows.description_zh:
平均扫描行数。

目前支持该字段的数据库：RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB MySQL版

AvgFetchRows.description_en: The average number of rows that are fetched by compute nodes from data nodes on the PolarDB-X 2.0 instance
AvgFetchRows.description_zh: PolarDB-X 2.0数据库实例计算节点平均拉取数据节点的行数

AvgLockWaitTime.description_en: The average lock wait latency. Unit: seconds
AvgLockWaitTime.description_zh: 平均锁等待时长，单位为秒

AvgLogicalRead.description_en: The average number of logical reads

AvgPhysicalAsyncRead.description_en: The average number of physical asynchronous reads

AvgPhysicalSyncRead.description_en: The average number of physical synchronous reads

AvgReturnedRows.description_en: The average number of returned rows

AvgSqlCount.description_en: The average number of SQL statements

AvgUpdatedRows.description_en:
The average number of updated rows.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and PolarDB-X 2.0 databases
AvgUpdatedRows.description_zh:
平均修改行数。

目前支持该字段的数据库：RDS MySQL、PolarDB-X 2.0

CountRate.description_en: The percentage of the total number of executions

ExaminedRows.description_en:
The total number of scanned rows.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for MySQL databases
ExaminedRows.description_zh:
总扫描行数。

目前支持该字段的数据库：RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB MySQL版

FetchRows.description_en: The number of rows that are fetched by compute nodes from data nodes on the PolarDB-X 2.0 instance
FetchRows.description_zh: PolarDB-X 2.0数据库实例计算节点拉取数据节点的行数

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the database instance

LockWaitTime.description_en: The lock wait latency. Unit: seconds

PhysicalAsyncRead.description_en: The number of physical asynchronous reads

PhysicalSyncRead.description_en: The number of physical synchronous reads

Port.description_en: The port number that is used to connect to the database instance

Rows.description_en: The total number of rows updated or returned by the compute nodes of the PolarDB-X 2.0 instance
Rows.description_zh: PolarDB-X 2.0数据库实例计算节点总更新或返回的行数

RtGreaterThanOneSecondCount.description_en: The number of SQL statements that take longer than 1 second to execute
RtGreaterThanOneSecondCount.description_zh: 执行时长大于1秒的SQL数量

SumUpdatedRows.description_en: The total number of updated rows

Tables.description_en: The names of tables in the database

items.description_en: The names of tables in the database

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

State.description_en:
The state of the asynchronous request. Valid values:

RUNNING

SUCCESS

FAIL
State.description_zh:
异步请求的执行状态。

RUNNING：正在运行。

SUCCESS：成功。

FAIL：失败

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the asynchronous request was sent. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
Timestamp.description_zh: 执行时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message that contains information such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
